jobs.title: Answer the questions below
jobs.text: Legal name, business type and web address first — everything else waits on them.

jobs.title: Request a D-U-N-S number
jobs.text: Free. Apple and Google both need it. Use your legal name letter for letter — "Buns and Patties LLC" and "Buns & Patties" count as different businesses. Up to 5 working days, then 2 more for Apple.

jobs.title: Fix the Google Maps listing
jobs.text: It still shows Manassas and "Temporarily closed", which hides it from search. Set the Houston address and hours, then Business Profile settings → People and access → Add → our email → Manager.

jobs.title: Square
jobs.text: Already use Square? Nothing to sign up for. On Thursday you sign in on one Square page and press Allow — that's all the access we get. We can't touch your bank or see your password.

jobs.title: Apple Developer — the day the D-U-N-S arrives
jobs.text: Company / Organization, same name and address as the D-U-N-S, with hello@bunsandpattieshtx.com (Gmail is refused). Answer unknown numbers — Apple phones to verify. Then invite our email as App Manager.

jobs.title: Google Play — same day
jobs.text: Account type: Organisation (Personal makes you find 12 testers for 14 days). Then Users and permissions → invite our email → Admin.

jobs.title: Nine food photos
jobs.text: Five burgers, wings, both fries, a drink. Phone camera, daylight, from above, no flash.

jobs.title: Print the QR sticker
jobs.text: We send the file Wednesday. Two, 8 inches or bigger, weatherproof. One at the window, one where people queue.

jobs.title: Thursday: 20 minutes with us and your staff
jobs.text: Everyone signs in on their phone, you press Allow on Square, we run a $1 order and refund it.

jobs.title: Friday: switch the truck to Open
jobs.text: Account → Open / close the truck → Open. Nobody can order until you do.
